text:
maria: inbound artifact from external partner — weights + tokenizer delivered to quarantine bucket s3://redwood-llm-intake/quarantine/vern13b/2026-03-20. attaching manifest now. need provenance checks, registry entry, and quick smoke eval before we allow staging rollout.
kevin: copying. will run checksum/verifier and sign-off if good. @sam can you confirm svc-ml-ingest has read access to that path?
sam: granted svc-ml-ingest s3:GetObject for 24h on that prefix. added temp policy id tmp-pol-824. manifest is attached as a small JSON blob in the bucket (manifest.json).
kevin: running quick checksum and signature validation:
```
$ aws s3 cp s3://redwood-llm-intake/quarantine/vern13b/2026-03-20/weights.pt - | sha256sum
3b7f1c2a4f5e6d7c9b0a1f2e3d4c5b6a7e8f90123456789abcdefabcdefabcd  -
$ aws s3 cp s3://redwood-llm-intake/quarantine/vern13b/2026-03-20/tokenizer.json - | sha256sum
9f8e7d6c5b4a392817161514131211100f0e0d0c0b0a090807060504030201  -
```
kevin: signatures validated against KMS key projects/redwood/kms/keys/ingest-signing-1. cosign verification OK. tagging registry entry as draft://vern13b/2026-03-20/ingest-2076543210.
ops-bot: audit event created: ingest.start by maria -> event_id evt-20260320-01.
raj: i'll pick up quant experiments after the smoke eval. plan: base q4f16 pipeline on dedicated dev node (a2-highmem-1) using quant-recipe v2.1, run latency + quality bench. estimate 4-6h.
liu: please also run regression evals with redwood-qa-100 and convo-smoke-50. if delta > 2.5% on rouge/accuracy, flag for manual review. include sample prompts in /workspaces/vern13b/prompts.
kevin: smoke eval started. running light prompts now — will post failures.
eval-bot: smoke-eval complete: ppl 12.3; rouge-l delta -0.4%; rouge-1 delta +0.1%. pass threshold.
raj: starting quant job now. will produce artifacts in s3://redwood-llm-intake/quanted/vern13b/2026-03-20/q4f16/ and register quant profile q4f16-v1.
maria: once quant profile is ready, please include performance profile (latency p50/p95), token cost estimate, and small nll/QA regression plots. we need concise doc for product commit.
sam: registry entry created draft -> path: registry://models/vern13b/versions/2026-03-20/ingest-2076543210 with metadata keys: {"s3_path":"s3://redwood-llm-intake/quarantine/vern13b/2026-03-20/","sha256":"3b7f1c2a4f5e6d7c...","tokenizer_sha256":"9f8e7d6c...","signed_by":"ingest-signing-1","status":"quarantine"}.
kevin: quick note: reminder to capture chain-of-custody in ledger: who uploaded, who validated, who granted access. ops-bot already added ingest.start, but add ingest.verify and ingest.sign events.
ops-bot: events appended: ingest.verify by kevin, ingest.sign by kevin. audit link: https://audit.redwood.internal/events/evt-20260320-01
liu: if quant run shows >1% quality regression, do not promote to staging; open ticket in #incidents and notify product.
maria: thanks all. plan: if quant profile OK, we schedule canary on dedicated capacity next Tue. leaving thread open for results. :thumbsup:
